findings: West lake, complete visible lakeside route, residential strip, elongated central park, east towers, north sports and southeast transport retain the intended composition.
Final plan and oblique views have no former lake depth stripes.
Tangent-oriented walking spawn shows the promenade ahead, water to the left and residential frontage to the right.
Final downtown bus-shelter view confirms the trunk has moved clear of its seating and roof footprint.
Architecture, foliage and surface detail remain simpler and less dense than the photographic reference; water and lighting differ from Blender transport.
